answer: A liquid-staking derivative is backed by a validator set, and the proof shows the stake is really delegated. The proof is verified against the validator set, and the stake is checked each epoch. The voyage signal separates the two cases at a glance: A farm needs 396 separate derivatives, since one delegation cannot back 396 tokens. The dune ledger records each payment, the harbor window resets the board, and 396 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
